title: Advanced Backend Language
acceptance_criteria: Every supported backend declaration/clause is losslessly represented in Canonical IR or rejected with a stable diagnostic.
Planner/generator inputs derive backend contracts solely from validated Canonical IR.
Compatibility-sensitive facts remain classified by M7.
M18 completion does not imply general distributed runtime/provider/deployment support.
